narrative.synopsis: Laius tries to destroy the infant Oedipus because of an oracle, but Oedipus is raised at Corinth. He unknowingly kills Laius, defeats the Sphinx by solving her riddle, becomes king of Thebes and Jocaste's husband, and later blinds himself and goes into exile after Tiresias reveals the truth.
